extracted.name: Spinach Frittata
extracted.description: This spinach frittata recipe is filled with spinach, ham, bell pepper, onion, and cheese for a delicious, quick brunch option made easy in a skillet.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup red bell pepper, cut into thin matchsticks
1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add red pepper and onion. Cook and stir until tender, about 5 minutes.
Beat eggs and milk together in a bowl until smooth; add spinach, ham, mozzarella cheese, feta cheese, salt, and black pepper. Gently stir to mix evenly; pour into the skillet.
Place a cover on the skillet and cook until the egg mixture is completely set in the center, 7 to 10 minutes. Cut into wedges to serve.
